jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List code-registered and runtime-registered jobs page by page, with schedules, state, next run time and last outcome.
jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Get one job by its name.
jobs.pause.title: Pause jobs
jobs.pause.description: Pause jobs in bulk: they stop firing on schedule, running ones are not affected, and they stay paused after a restart.
jobs.resume.title: Resume jobs
jobs.resume.description: Resume jobs in bulk; they continue from their next scheduled fire time.
jobs.trigger.title: Run job now
jobs.trigger.description: Queue a one-off manual trigger so any node runs the job once now, without waiting for the result, and return the trigger name; paused jobs can run too.
jobs.validate_schedule.title: Validate schedule
jobs.validate_schedule.description: Validate a cron expression or schedule text and return its normal form and the next run times; no job is changed.
job_runs.list.title: List job runs
job_runs.list.description: List job run history page by page (newest scheduled first), filterable by job, state, trigger, time and failure; runs are kept for the days configured in the framework.
openapi.tags.job_runs.name: Job runs
openapi.tags.job_runs.description: Each job run with its times, state, node and failure reason.
maintenance.platform_only: This is only available on the platform side.
maintenance.query.filter_unsupported: Filtering by {field} with {operator} is not supported.
openapi.tags.jobs.name: Jobs
openapi.tags.jobs.description: Scheduled jobs: state, pause and resume, run now and schedule validation.
openapi.groups.maintenance.name: Maintenance
openapi.groups.maintenance.description: Job scheduling and run history, plus the database version ledger and upgrade records.
permissions.maintenance.jobs.read.name: Read jobs
permissions.maintenance.jobs.update.name: Pause and resume jobs
versions.list.title: List versions
versions.list.description: List each database's version ledger page by page: schema version, the app version and time of the last upgrade, and whether an upgrade is running; maintained by the upgrade runner, read-only.
versions.get.title: Get version
versions.get.description: Get one version ledger row by ID.
migrations.list.title: List upgrade records
migrations.list.description: List upgrade script records page by page (successes and failures), newest first by default, filterable by version, script, node, outcome and time.
migrations.get.title: Get upgrade record
migrations.get.description: Get one upgrade script record by ID, including the failure reason.
openapi.tags.versions.name: Versions
openapi.tags.versions.description: Each database's version ledger: schema version, upgrade lock and last upgrade.
openapi.tags.migrations.name: Upgrade records
openapi.tags.migrations.description: Each upgrade script run: version, script, duration, outcome and node.
jobs.reschedule.title: Reschedule job
jobs.reschedule.description: Replace a job's schedule (a cron expression or schedule text) and keep the rest of its registration and its paused state. A code job changed this way is marked overridden and keeps the change across restarts while its code definition is unchanged. The job must have a single trigger. Platform side only.
jobs.restore.title: Restore code definitions
jobs.restore.description: Restore jobs to the definitions registered in code (discarding runtime schedule changes) and keep their paused state; jobs without a code definition fail item by item. Platform side only.
jobs.types.title: List job types
jobs.types.description: List the registered job types (ordinal order), used to filter the job list by type. Platform side only.
maintenance.jobs.type_unknown: The type '{type}' of job '{id}' is not registered, so its schedule cannot be changed.
maintenance.jobs.triggers_many: Job '{id}' has {count} triggers; its schedule cannot be replaced as a whole.
